current_evidence: The accessible Local Scheme of Validation page states it was adopted January 2024 and 'revised January 2026', and search returns the matching local-scheme-of-validation-2026.pdf as the latest PDF.

issues.detail: Householder recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but section 4 lists Householder local requirements: Additional plans, Archaeological Assessment, Block Plan, CIL Forms, Design Code Compliance Statement, Ecology Report, Flood Risk Assessment, Greenbelt Impact/Volume calculation, Land Contamination Assessment, Levels and Cross Sections, Photographs and Photomontages, Planning Statement, Site Survey Existing, Structural Survey, Tree Survey/AIA, Vehicle Parking and Cycle Storage.

Outline, Reserved matters and Advertisement consent recorded as '(none)'. The scheme has five Outline lists (e.g. Outline Minor Residential has ~34 local items incl. Aerodrome Safeguarding, BNG, Master Plan, Transport Assessment) and Advertisement consent requires Block Plan, External Lighting Scheme, Light Impact Assessment, Planning Statement, Site Survey Existing.
issues.evidence: Section 4 'Outline Application - Minor Residential (up to 0.5ha): Local Requirements'; 'Advertisement Consent, Local Requirements'

issues.detail: Listed building consent gets only 3 items, one of which ('Advertisement drawings / illumination details') is not on the LBC list. The source LBC list has 19 local items incl. Block Plan, Design Code Compliance Statement, Ecology Report, Heritage Statement, Structural Survey, Tree Survey, Ventilation/Extraction Statement.

About 50 items are placed under Full planning as 'INFERRED: application type not named', although section 4 of the source gives explicit per-application-type lists (Full Minor Other, Full Major etc.).
issues.evidence: Section 4 lists requirements under each application type

issues.detail: Not captured: Aerodrome Safeguarding Assessment (development affecting protected surfaces/bird hazard, esp. near East Midlands Airport); Building for a Healthy Life Assessment (all major residential); Design Code Process Note (major); Glint and Glare (solar/PV affecting receptors); Greenbelt Impact/Volume Calculation (householder extensions/outbuildings and all development in Green Belt); Evidence Statement (LDCs, proof of need); Site Survey Existing; Affordable Housing Statement (11+ units or 1,000 sq m+, specialist older persons housing).

Grokbot read obsolete or non-validation documents and mixed them in: rbc_developer_checklist.pdf (references PPS12, East Midlands Regional Plan 2009, 2003 SPGs, SCI 2007) and Local Plan Part 1/Part 2 text. Several triggers come from Local Plan policy, not the validation list (e.g. Air Quality Assessment, Habitats Regulations, Equality statement, Housing mix, Water efficiency, Gypsy & Traveller, Minerals/Waste).

23 'Submission rules' tab items are mostly boilerplate, contacts or garbled link text from the old developer checklist ('More information can be viewed at ... PPS12 Local Spatial Planning ...', 'Developer Requirements, adopted December 2003 ... Contact:', 'given 14 days to submit the additional information'). 'Equality / accessibility statement' row is Core Strategy text about its own Equality Impact Assessment.

'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' uses the Agricultural Land Classification trigger; source has a separate 'Agricultural Justification' required for a countryside dwelling for agricultural or equestrian purposes. 'CIL Additional Information' and 'Design Code' share one garbled excerpt. 'Cycle parking details' excerpt runs into '10 Transport Assessment'. 'Viability Assessment' excerpt is about who pays consultant fees, not when required.
issues.evidence: Section 6: 'Agricultural Justification: erection of a countryside dwelling for agricultural or equestrian purposes'

issues.detail: Drawing standards repeated from both the HTML page and the PDF ('A linear scale bar ... and A unique plan / drawing reference number' appears combined and again as two separate items).

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Local Scheme of Validation (revised January 2026), but Grokbot ignored its explicit per-application-type lists (Householder, Outline, Advertisement shown as 'none') and padded the output with Local Plan and 2000s developer-checklist text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
